ns2:course.label: Remedies
ns2:course.description: Survey of legal and equitable remedies for the protection of personal and property rights. Procedural and substantive aspects of injunctions; restitution of unjust enrichment in the context of the receipt of unsolicited benefits, benefits derived from the commission of tortious acts, and the mistaken acquisition of benefits; alternative remedies arising from bargain transactions; and remedies for violations of civil rights. 2 or 4 graduate hours. 2 to 3 professional hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 or 4 graduate hours. 2 to 3 professional hours.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
